name: Gmail Multi-Label to Sheets and Drive

parameters.content:
PORTABLE / INACTIVE EXPORT

Replace every REPLACE_* value before use. The three Gmail searches are read-only: they do not mark read, archive, or change labels. Configure n8n binary data mode as filesystem/separate storage. The rolling 48-hour replay window is made safe by Sheet upserts and Drive appProperties.

parameters.jsCode:
const normalized = $('Normalize Gmail Message').item;
  return { json: { ...normalized.json }, binary: normalized.binary };
return { json: { ...$json, status: 'NO_ATTACHMENTS', error: '', processed_at: new Date().toISOString() } };

parameters.queryString: ={{ "mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and name = '" + $json.label.replace(/'/g, "\'") + "' and 'REPLACE_GMAIL_ATTACHMENTS_ROOT_FOLDER_ID' in parents and trashed = false" }}

parameters.jsCode:
const source = $('Restore Gmail Context').item;
return { json: { ...source.json, label_search_id: String($json.id || '') } };
return { json: { ...$json, label_folder_id: $json.label_search_id } };

const source = $('Attach Label Search Result').item;
return { json: { ...source.json, label_folder_id: String($json.id || '') } };

parameters.queryString: ={{ "mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and name = '" + $json.received_date + "' and '" + $json.label_folder_id + "' in parents and trashed = false" }}

parameters.jsCode:
const source = $('Merge Label Folder').item;
return { json: { ...source.json, date_search_id: String($json.id || '') } };
return { json: { ...$json, date_folder_id: $json.date_search_id } };

const source = $('Attach Date Search Result').item;
return { json: { ...source.json, date_folder_id: String($json.id || '') } };

parameters.queryString: ={{ "mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and name = '" + $json.sender_folder.replace(/'/g, "\'") + "' and '" + $json.date_folder_id + "' in parents and trashed = false" }}

parameters.jsCode:
const source = $('Merge Date Folder').item;
return { json: { ...source.json, sender_search_id: String($json.id || '') } };
return { json: { ...$json, sender_folder_id: $json.sender_search_id } };

const source = $('Attach Sender Search Result').item;
return { json: { ...source.json, sender_folder_id: String($json.id || '') } };
return { json: { ...$json, folder_url: 'https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/' + $json.sender_folder_id } };
return { json: { ...$json, start_new_attachment_loop: true }, binary: $binary };

parameters.queryString: ={{ "appProperties has { key='document_intake_attachment_key' and value='" + $json.attachment_key.replace(/'/g, "\'") + "' } and '" + $json.sender_folder_id + "' in parents and trashed = false" }}

parameters.jsCode: return { json: { ...$json }, binary: $binary };
return { json: { ...$json, start_new_attachment_loop: false }, binary: $binary };
